caveats: No owned builds/tests overlap FUSE measurement; shared host is not isolated.
Default baseline round 3 had write outliers (10.10 MiB/s and 22.97 files/s), retained without attributing a cause.
Strict vs fsync compares different explicitly selected durability boundaries; ordinary NORMAL writes require a later barrier for host-crash durability.
The native loss test reopens successful xSync images; it is a deterministic storage-loss model, not a physical power-cut test.
